'''Kombat''' is a 2on2on2 tournament played '''Saturday 5th March''', 22:00 {{Abbr/CET}}.
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. 

== Format ==
* 3 groups
** 3 teams per group.
** Winners of each group to final round.
* Servers: probably qw.foppa.dk or qw.quakeworld.fi
* Server settings:
** 2on2on2
** DMM3
** Powerups ON
** Timelimit: 20
* Start 22:00 {{Abbr/CET}}

== Rules ==
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|Alice|flag=se}}
